blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: Grouping / Family Approach | 分組 / 家族方法
blocks.en: Grouping / Family Approach

blocks.zh: 中文解說 | Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 分組策略核心概念
blocks.en: Core Concepts of a Grouping Strategy

blocks.zh: 分組（Grouping）的本質是用「最差情況」代表一組，避免對每個產品/設備都做完整驗證，以節省資源。又稱：
blocks.en: Grouping uses the "worst case" to represent a whole group, so that full validation is not needed for every product or piece of equipment, saving resources. It is also known as:

blocks.zh: Matrixing（矩陣法）：在矩陣架構內選代表性組合
blocks.en: Matrixing: select representative combinations within a matrix design

blocks.zh: Family Approach（家族法）：同類產品當一個家族
blocks.en: Family Approach: treat similar products as one family

blocks.zh: Bracketing（括弧法）：選最大與最小的極端值
blocks.en: Bracketing: select the extreme (largest and smallest) values

blocks.zh: 前提條件：所有組內產品/設備必須使用相同的清潔製程。
blocks.en: Prerequisite: all products/equipment in the group must use the same cleaning process.

blocks.zh: 比喻：公寓大樓的消防演習
blocks.en: Analogy: A Fire Drill in an Apartment Building

blocks.zh: 想像一棟有 20 層樓的大樓，每層格局相同。消防局不需要在每層都演習，只要選「最難疏散」的樓層（例如人最多的樓層）做完整演練，其他樓層就可以類比驗證通過。這就是「最差情況代表」的邏輯。
blocks.en: Imagine a 20-story building in which every floor has the same layout. The fire department does not need to run a drill on every floor. It picks the floor that is hardest to evacuate (for example, the one with the most people), runs a full drill there, and the other floors can be considered covered by analogy. This is the logic of worst-case representation.

blocks.zh: 新產品/設備加入群組的風險判斷
blocks.en: Risk Assessment When a New Product/Equipment Joins a Group

blocks.zh: 比現有最差情況容易清潔：可僅做實驗室確認或確認性驗證（confirmatory protocol）
blocks.en: Easier to clean than the existing worst case: laboratory confirmation or a confirmatory protocol is sufficient

blocks.zh: 比現有最差情況更難清潔：必須以新產品作為新最差情況，重新做完整驗證
blocks.en: Harder to clean than the existing worst case: the new product must become the new worst case and full validation must be repeated

blocks.zh: 新identical設備：確認等效即可，或加一次確認性驗證
blocks.en: New identical equipment: confirming equivalence is sufficient, or add one confirmatory validation run

blocks.zh: 新similar設備（非新最差情況）：僅 visually clean 確認性驗證即可
blocks.en: New similar equipment (not a new worst case): a confirmatory validation with a visually clean check only is sufficient

blocks.zh: 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical Points

blocks.zh: 分組策略必須記載於驗證主計畫（Validation Master Plan, VMP）中，並有充分的科學依據。PQ 最少執行 3 次驗證運作（runs）是基本要求。
blocks.en: The grouping strategy must be documented in the Validation Master Plan (VMP) with sound scientific justification. Performing at least 3 validation runs in PQ is a basic requirement.

blocks.zh: Cleaning Agent Issues | 清潔劑議題
blocks.en: Cleaning Agent Issues

blocks.zh: 生技廠典型清潔流程架構
blocks.en: Typical Cleaning Process Structure in a Biotech Facility

blocks.zh: Pre-rinse（水預沖）
blocks.en: Pre-rinse (water)

blocks.zh: Alkaline Wash（鹼洗）NaOH
blocks.en: Alkaline wash (NaOH)

blocks.zh: Acid Wash（酸洗）可選
blocks.en: Acid wash (optional)

blocks.zh: Water Rinse × 多次（水沖×多次）
blocks.en: Water rinse × multiple

blocks.zh: Rouge（紅色沉積物）是什麼？
blocks.en: What Is Rouge?

blocks.zh: Rouge 是不鏽鋼設備表面因氧化鐵沉積形成的紅棕色薄膜，在 SIP（蒸氣滅菌）或高溫製程中尤其常見。雖然不一定直接危害產品，但代表表面鈍化層受損，需定期進行 derouging（除 Rouge）處理。
blocks.en: Rouge is a thin red-brown film formed on stainless steel equipment surfaces by iron oxide deposition, especially common during SIP (steam sterilization) or high-temperature processes. It does not necessarily harm the product directly, but it indicates that the passivation layer has been damaged, so periodic derouging is required.

blocks.zh: 清潔劑選擇 9 大考量要素
blocks.en: Nine Key Considerations When Selecting a Cleaning Agent

blocks.zh: 可沖洗性（Rinsability）— 殘留量是否容易洗淨
blocks.en: Rinsability: how easily residues are rinsed away

blocks.zh: 品質與一致性
blocks.en: Quality and consistency

blocks.zh: 基材相容性（不鏽鋼、橡膠墊圈等）
blocks.en: Compatibility with materials of construction (stainless steel, rubber gaskets, etc.)

blocks.zh: 穩定性（濃度不隨時間改變）
blocks.en: Stability (concentration does not change over time)

blocks.zh: 安全性與毒性
blocks.en: Safety and toxicity

blocks.zh: 分析方法適用性（是否有 TOC/conductivity 方法）
blocks.en: Suitability of analytical methods (e.g., whether a TOC/conductivity method is available)

blocks.zh: 環境法規合規
blocks.en: Environmental regulatory compliance

blocks.zh: 長期供貨保障
blocks.en: Long-term supply assurance

blocks.zh: 廣效清潔能力
blocks.en: Broad-spectrum cleaning capability

blocks.zh: Special Equipment Issues | 特殊設備議題
blocks.en: Special Equipment Issues

blocks.zh: 特殊設備清潔驗證共同原則
blocks.en: Common Principles for Cleaning Validation of Special Equipment

blocks.zh: 本節三類設備（層析管柱、TFF 膜系統、離心機）雖然清潔方式特殊，但有一個共同結論：
blocks.en: Although the three types of equipment in this section (chromatography columns, TFF membrane systems and centrifuges) are cleaned in special ways, they share one conclusion:

blocks.zh: 完成清潔後，可套用與儲罐相同的清潔驗證原則（同樣的限度標準）。
blocks.en: Once cleaned, the same cleaning validation principles as for storage tanks (the same limit criteria) can be applied.

blocks.zh: 層析管柱（Chromatography Column）清潔特點
blocks.en: Cleaning Characteristics of Chromatography Columns

blocks.zh: Campaign 批次間：樹脂裝填狀態下清潔，樹脂清潔同時清潔管柱內壁
blocks.en: Between campaign batches: the column is cleaned with the resin packed, and cleaning the resin also cleans the column's inner wall

blocks.zh: Campaign 結束換產品：必須先卸下樹脂，再做空柱清潔
blocks.en: At the end of a campaign when changing products: the resin must first be unpacked, and the empty column then cleaned

blocks.zh: Column frits / sieves（過濾篩）：因孔隙結構難以完全驗證殘留去除，通常為產品專用（dedicated），換產品時移除保存，不做清潔驗證
blocks.en: Column frits / sieves: because their pore structure makes it difficult to fully verify residue removal, they are usually dedicated to a product; they are removed and stored when the product changes and are not included in cleaning validation

blocks.zh: TFF 系統清潔特點
blocks.en: Cleaning Characteristics of TFF Systems

blocks.zh: 膜片（membrane）清潔 = 同時清潔 housing 內壁
blocks.en: Cleaning the membrane also cleans the inner wall of the housing

blocks.zh: 膜片移除後，仍需對空的 housing 做正式清潔
blocks.en: After the membrane is removed, the empty housing still requires formal cleaning

blocks.zh: 清潔方法通常與儲罐相同（鹼洗 + 水沖）
blocks.en: The cleaning method is usually the same as for storage tanks (alkaline wash + water rinse)

blocks.zh: 詳細膜片清潔驗證參照 PDA TR15
blocks.en: For details on membrane cleaning validation, refer to PDA TR15

blocks.zh: 離心機清潔挑戰：死角（Hard-to-Access Areas）
blocks.en: Centrifuge Cleaning Challenge: Hard-to-Access Areas

blocks.zh: 離心機的碗（bowl）、轉子（rotor）、碟片（disc stack）等部件結構複雜，難以確保所有接觸面都能被清潔液有效沖刷到。驗證重點：
blocks.en: Centrifuge components such as the bowl, rotor and disc stack have complex geometries, making it difficult to ensure that cleaning solution effectively flushes all contact surfaces. Validation focus:

blocks.zh: 清潔製程設計時需確認清潔液覆蓋死角的方式
blocks.en: During cleaning process design, confirm how the cleaning solution reaches hard-to-access areas

blocks.zh: 取樣時必須包含難到達區域的棉棒取樣（swab sampling）
blocks.en: Sampling must include swab sampling of hard-to-reach areas

blocks.zh: 部分離心機可 CIP，部分必須手動拆卸清潔
blocks.en: Some centrifuges can be cleaned by CIP, while others must be disassembled and cleaned manually

blocks.zh: Multi-Host Facilities | 多產品廠房
blocks.en: Multi-Host Facilities

blocks.zh: 多產品廠房（Multi-Host Facility）的挑戰
blocks.en: Challenges of a Multi-Host Facility

blocks.zh: 當同一設備用於製造不同生物製劑產品時（例如：細胞培養 + 細菌發酵共用設備），清潔驗證必須涵蓋更廣泛的污染來源：
blocks.en: When the same equipment is used to make different biological products (for example, shared equipment for cell culture and bacterial fermentation), cleaning validation must cover a wider range of contamination sources:

blocks.zh: 產品殘留（previous product residues）
blocks.en: Previous product residues

blocks.zh: 清潔劑殘留（cleaning agent residues）
blocks.en: Cleaning agent residues

blocks.zh: 製程特定殘留（培養基、緩衝液、抗泡劑）
blocks.en: Process-specific residues (culture media, buffers, antifoams)

blocks.zh: 生物負荷控制（bioburden, endotoxin）
blocks.en: Bioburden control (bioburden, endotoxin)

blocks.zh: 核心風險：共用設備的交叉污染
blocks.en: Core Risk: Cross-Contamination on Shared Equipment

blocks.zh: 多產品廠房的清潔驗證不只是「下一個產品的安全性」問題，還要確保清潔/消毒/切換程序（cleaning/sanitization/changeover procedures）對廠房內所有產品都有效。
blocks.en: Cleaning validation in a multi-host facility is not only about the safety of the next product. It must also ensure that the cleaning/sanitization/changeover procedures are effective for all products in the facility.

blocks.zh: 驗證策略需考慮：不同宿主細胞系的特性差異（例如：哺乳動物細胞 vs. 大腸桿菌），以及各步驟所需的特定控制措施。
blocks.en: The validation strategy must consider differences between host cell lines (for example, mammalian cells vs. E. coli) and the specific controls required at each step.

blocks.zh: Contract Manufacturer（CDMO）的特殊意義
blocks.en: Special Significance for a Contract Manufacturer (CDMO)

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO（委託製造商）而言，multi-host facility 是常態。每次接受新客戶產品時，都必須評估是否需要更新清潔驗證，以確保不同客戶產品間不發生交叉污染。這是 CDMO 清潔驗證計畫的核心挑戰之一。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, a multi-host facility is the norm. Each time a new client's product is accepted, it must be assessed whether the cleaning validation needs to be updated, to ensure that no cross-contamination occurs between different clients' products. This is one of the core challenges of a CDMO's cleaning validation program.

blocks.zh: Non-Product Contact Surfaces | 非產品接觸表面
blocks.en: Non-Product Contact Surfaces

blocks.zh: 凍乾機比喻：鄰居效應
blocks.en: Freeze Dryer Analogy: The Neighbor Effect

blocks.zh: 凍乾機的層板（shelf）並不直接碰到藥品瓶，但就像在密閉空間裡「隔壁鄰居抽菸」的概念——殘留物可能以氣態/微粒形式飄移進開口的產品瓶中。這就是為什麼凍乾機需要清潔驗證，即使它不是「直接接觸表面」。
blocks.en: The shelves of a freeze dryer do not directly touch the drug vials, but, like a neighbor smoking next door in an enclosed space, residues can drift as vapor or particles into open product vials. This is why a freeze dryer needs cleaning validation even though it is not a "direct contact surface."

blocks.zh: 凍乾機限度設定的特殊邏輯
blocks.en: Special Logic for Setting Freeze Dryer Limits

blocks.zh: 因為無法用傳統「殘留攜帶計算」（carryover calculation）來設定限度，凍乾機的 TOC 限度選擇方式：
blocks.en: Because the traditional carryover calculation cannot be used to set limits, the TOC limit for a freeze dryer is chosen in one of two ways:

blocks.zh: 方法 A：任何棉棒解吸樣品中 TOC ≤ 10 ppm
blocks.en: Approach A: TOC ≤ 10 ppm in any swab desorption sample

blocks.zh: 方法 B：採用前後直接接觸設備的相同 TOC 限度
blocks.en: Approach B: apply the same TOC limit used for the directly product-contact equipment before and after it

blocks.zh: 邏輯：間接接觸的風險低於直接接觸，只要符合直接接觸的標準，產品就受到充分保護。
blocks.en: Rationale: indirect contact carries a lower risk than direct contact, so as long as the criteria for direct contact are met, the product is adequately protected.

blocks.zh: Viruses, Mycoplasma and Prions | 病毒、黴漿菌與普恩蛋白
blocks.en: Viruses, Mycoplasma and Prions

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證 vs. 病毒去活化研究：重要邊界
blocks.en: Cleaning Validation vs. Viral Clearance Studies: An Important Boundary

blocks.zh: 這是生技廠常被混淆的概念：
blocks.en: This is a concept often confused in biotech facilities:

blocks.zh: 病毒（Viruses）：不在清潔驗證範圍內，歸屬於病毒去活化研究（Viral Clearance Study）及製程驗證
blocks.en: Viruses: outside the scope of cleaning validation; they fall under Viral Clearance Studies and process validation

blocks.zh: 清潔製程：可作為整體生物污染控制策略的輔助手段，但不是主要控制措施
blocks.en: Cleaning process: can serve as a supporting measure within the overall biological contamination control strategy, but is not the primary control

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證的主要目標是：產品殘留 + 清潔劑殘留，而非生物污染
blocks.en: The main objectives of cleaning validation are product residues and cleaning agent residues, not biological contamination

blocks.zh: 比喻：普恩蛋白是「終極難敵」
blocks.en: Analogy: Prions Are the "Ultimate Enemy"

blocks.zh: 普恩蛋白（Prion / TSE agent）是已知最難去活化的生物污染物——它能耐受一般的熱處理、福馬林、紫外線，甚至某些消毒劑。FDA 指出即使使用 1N NaOH 或高壓蒸氣（132°C，1-4 小時），也只能「減少但未必完全消滅」感染性。這就是為什麼動物來源原料的控制（vendor certification）如此關鍵。
blocks.en: Prions (TSE agents) are the most difficult biological contaminants known to inactivate. They withstand ordinary heat treatment, formalin and ultraviolet light, and even some disinfectants. The FDA notes that even 1N NaOH or autoclaving (132°C, 1-4 hours) can only "reduce but not necessarily eliminate" infectivity. This is why control of animal-derived raw materials (vendor certification) is so critical.

blocks.zh: NaOH 在病毒控制的雙重角色
blocks.en: The Dual Role of NaOH in Viral Control

blocks.zh: NaOH 在生技廠有兩個角色：
blocks.en: NaOH plays two roles in a biotech facility:

blocks.zh: 清潔（Cleaning）：去除有機殘留、溶解蛋白質
blocks.en: Cleaning: removes organic residues and dissolves proteins

blocks.zh: 病毒去活化輔助（Viral Inactivation Support）：高 pH 環境可使大多數病毒失去活性
blocks.en: Viral Inactivation Support: a high-pH environment inactivates most viruses

blocks.zh: 但兩者的驗證框架不同，不能互相替代。
blocks.en: However, the validation frameworks for the two differ, and one cannot substitute for the other.

blocks.zh: Single-Use Equipment | 一次性使用設備
blocks.en: Single-Use Equipment

blocks.zh: Extractables & Leachables（E&L）：SUS 的核心風險
blocks.en: Extractables & Leachables (E&L): The Core Risk of SUS

blocks.zh: Extractables（萃出物）：在極端條件（高溫、強溶劑）下從聚合物材料中被萃取出的化學物質——在實驗室條件下測定。
blocks.en: Extractables: chemicals extracted from polymer materials under extreme conditions (high temperature, strong solvents), determined under laboratory conditions.

blocks.zh: Leachables（滲出物）：在實際製程條件下從材料中遷移進入產品的物質——是真正的安全性關注點。
blocks.en: Leachables: substances that migrate from the material into the product under actual process conditions; these are the real safety concern.

blocks.zh: E&L 評估通常作為製程驗證的一部分，需確認符合 USP <661>、ICH Q3D（元素雜質）等標準。
blocks.en: E&L assessment is usually part of process validation and must confirm compliance with standards such as USP <661> and ICH Q3D (elemental impurities).

blocks.zh: 比喻：SUS 就像一次性手術手套
blocks.en: Analogy: SUS Are Like Disposable Surgical Gloves

blocks.zh: 外科醫生每次手術使用全新的無菌手套，使用後丟棄，完全不需要「清潔驗證手套是否乾淨」。但必須確認手套材質不會讓對某些物質過敏（萃出物問題）。SUS 在生技製造中扮演同樣的角色。
blocks.en: A surgeon uses a fresh pair of sterile gloves for every operation and discards them afterward, with no need to "validate that the gloves are clean." But it must be confirmed that the glove material will not cause an allergic reaction to certain substances (the extractables issue). SUS play the same role in biotech manufacturing.

blocks.zh: CDMO 視角：SUS 的戰略優勢
blocks.en: CDMO Perspective: The Strategic Advantage of SUS

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，SUS 的最大優勢在於：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the biggest advantages of SUS are:

blocks.zh: 快速換產品（產品切換）：不需等待清潔驗證
blocks.en: Fast product changeover: no need to wait for cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 降低批次間交叉污染風險
blocks.en: Lower risk of batch-to-batch cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 縮短設備準備時間（快速周轉）
blocks.en: Shorter equipment preparation time (fast turnaround)

blocks.zh: 減少清潔用水和化學品消耗
blocks.en: Reduced consumption of cleaning water and chemicals

blocks.zh: Process Analytical Technology (PAT) | 製程分析技術
blocks.en: Process Analytical Technology (PAT)

blocks.zh: PAT 的核心定義
blocks.en: Core Definition of PAT

blocks.zh: FDA 定義：PAT 是「在製造過程中透過即時量測，對原料和製程中物料的關鍵品質與性能屬性進行設計、分析和控制的系統，目的是確保最終產品品質。」
blocks.en: FDA definition: PAT is "a system for designing, analyzing, and controlling manufacturing through timely measurements of critical quality and performance attributes of raw and in-process materials, with the goal of ensuring final product quality."

blocks.zh: 關鍵字：即時量測（timely measurement）+ 反饋控制（feedback loop）
blocks.en: Key words: timely measurement + feedback loop

blocks.zh: 比喻：PAT 就像洗碗機的感測器洗碗
blocks.en: Analogy: PAT Is Like a Dishwasher with a Sensor

blocks.zh:
傳統清潔：設定30分鐘，不管乾不乾淨都洗30分鐘。
PAT 清潔：安裝水質感測器，偵測到排水電導度低於設定值（水夠乾淨了）才停止，可能20分鐘就夠，也可能需要35分鐘。這樣更有彈性，也更有科學依據。
blocks.en:
Traditional cleaning: set 30 minutes, and wash for 30 minutes whether or not the dishes are clean.
PAT cleaning: install a water-quality sensor and stop only when the drain conductivity falls below the set value (the water is clean enough). It may take 20 minutes or 35 minutes. This is more flexible and more scientifically justified.

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：快速方法 ≠ PAT
blocks.en: Important Reminder: Rapid Method ≠ PAT

blocks.zh: 「快速方法（rapid method）」和「線上監控（online monitoring）」本身不等於 PAT。只有當量測結果直接控制製程步驟的完成時，才算是 PAT 應用。例如：
blocks.en: A "rapid method" or "online monitoring" is not by itself PAT. It counts as a PAT application only when the measurement result directly controls the completion of a process step. For example:

blocks.zh: 線上 TOC 作為沖洗步驟的完成控制參數 → PAT
blocks.en: Online TOC used as the completion control parameter for a rinse step → PAT

blocks.zh: 線上 TOC 只是記錄數據、事後確認 → 非 PAT，只是快速監控
blocks.en: Online TOC that only records data for after-the-fact confirmation → not PAT, just rapid monitoring

blocks.zh: Product Changeover | 產品切換
blocks.en: Product Changeover

blocks.zh: 生技製造的 Campaign 邏輯
blocks.en: Campaign Logic in Biotech Manufacturing

blocks.zh: Campaign（批次系列）：同一產品連續多批次生產，中間只做清潔，不換產品。Campaign 結束後切換到新產品，稱為 Product Changeover（產品切換）。
blocks.en: Campaign: the same product is made in consecutive batches with only cleaning in between and no product change. Switching to a new product after the campaign ends is called a Product Changeover.

blocks.zh: 批次1 → 清潔 → 批次2 → 清潔 → 批次3（Campaign A）
blocks.en: Batch 1 → clean → Batch 2 → clean → Batch 3 (Campaign A)

blocks.zh: ↓ Changeover（切換）
blocks.en: ↓ Changeover

blocks.zh: 批次1 → 清潔 → 批次2（Campaign B）
blocks.en: Batch 1 → clean → Batch 2 (Campaign B)

blocks.zh: 產品切換的標準程序
blocks.en: Standard Product Changeover Procedure

blocks.zh: 執行已驗證的清潔程序（第一次清潔）
blocks.en: Perform the validated cleaning procedure (first cleaning)

blocks.zh: 更換 soft parts（墊圈、O-ring 等橡膠軟性零件）
blocks.en: Replace soft parts (gaskets, O-rings and other soft rubber parts)

blocks.zh: 進行更全面的目視檢查
blocks.en: Perform a more thorough visual inspection

blocks.zh: 重新組裝設備
blocks.en: Reassemble the equipment

blocks.zh: 再次執行已驗證的清潔程序（第二次清潔）
blocks.en: Perform the validated cleaning procedure again (second cleaning)

blocks.zh: 按常規監控取樣（部分公司加做 ELISA 確認前一個活性蛋白殘留）
blocks.en: Take routine monitoring samples (some companies also run an ELISA to confirm no residual previous active protein)

blocks.zh: 為什麼要更換 Soft Parts（軟性零件）？
blocks.en: Why Replace Soft Parts?

blocks.zh: 墊圈（gasket）材質（矽膠、PTFE、EPDM）的微觀孔隙和與不鏽鋼的接縫間隙，可能吸附少量活性物質，清潔劑難以完全清除。這種「遷移風險」在換產品時需要特別處理。
blocks.en: The microscopic pores of gasket materials (silicone, PTFE, EPDM) and the gaps where they meet the stainless steel may adsorb small amounts of active substance that the cleaning agent cannot fully remove. This "migration risk" needs special handling at product changeover.

blocks.zh: 替代方案：若有實驗數據（實驗室模擬、放大研究、商業設備研究）證明無遷移風險，可以選擇不更換 soft parts，用一次清潔驗證流程涵蓋批次間清潔和 campaign 切換兩種情境。
blocks.en: Alternative: if experimental data (laboratory simulation, scale-up studies, commercial equipment studies) show there is no migration risk, soft parts may be left in place, and a single cleaning validation approach can cover both between-batch cleaning and campaign changeover scenarios.

blocks.zh: 產品專用設備
blocks.en: Dedicated Equipment

blocks.zh: 某些設備是「產品專用（dedicated）」的——最常見的是：
blocks.en: Some equipment is "dedicated" to a product. The most common examples are:

blocks.zh: 層析樹脂（chromatography resins）：Campaign 結束後清潔但不轉用於其他產品
blocks.en: Chromatography resins: cleaned after the campaign ends but not reused for other products

blocks.zh: 超濾膜（ultrafilters）：同上處理方式
blocks.en: Ultrafilters: handled in the same way

blocks.zh: 這類設備的產品專用設計大幅簡化了清潔驗證的複雜度。
blocks.en: The product-dedicated design of this equipment greatly simplifies the complexity of cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: Clean Hold Considerations | 清潔後保留考量
blocks.en: Clean Hold Considerations

blocks.zh: 清潔後儲存的最佳策略
blocks.en: Best Strategy for Storage After Cleaning

blocks.zh: 最佳：乾燥儲存（Dry State）
blocks.en: Best: dry storage (dry state)

blocks.zh: ↓ 若無法完全乾燥
blocks.en: ↓ If it cannot be fully dried

blocks.zh: 次佳：抑菌溶液儲存（如稀鹼液）
blocks.en: Second best: storage in a bacteriostatic solution (e.g., dilute alkali)

blocks.zh: ↓ 若含水儲存
blocks.en: ↓ If stored wet

blocks.zh: 必做：Clean Hold Validation（確立最大保存時限）
blocks.en: Required: Clean Hold Validation (establish the maximum hold time)

blocks.zh: Clean Hold 研究設計要點
blocks.en: Key Points of Clean Hold Study Design

blocks.zh: 取樣時機：儲存開始時（T0）+ 預設儲存時限後（T_max）
blocks.en: Sampling time points: at the start of storage (T0) + after the predetermined hold time (T_max)

blocks.zh: 取樣方式：沖洗取樣用常溫水（熱水會殺菌，導致低估）
blocks.en: Sampling method: rinse sampling with ambient-temperature water (hot water would kill microorganisms and cause underestimation)

blocks.zh: 量測項目：生物負荷（bioburden） ± 內毒素（endotoxin）
blocks.en: Measured parameters: bioburden ± endotoxin

blocks.zh: 沖洗量：基於系統最小工作體積或 CIP 最小設計沖洗量
blocks.en: Rinse volume: based on the minimum working volume of the system or the minimum CIP design rinse volume

blocks.zh: 均勻性：取樣前充分攪拌，確保樣品均勻
blocks.en: Homogeneity: mix thoroughly before sampling to ensure a uniform sample

blocks.zh: 超過 Clean Hold 時限的應對措施
blocks.en: Actions When the Clean Hold Time Is Exceeded

blocks.zh: 若超過已驗證的保存時限，可採取以下措施（選一）：
blocks.en: If the validated hold time is exceeded, one of the following actions can be taken (choose one):

blocks.zh: 重新清潔（Re-clean）：使用已驗證的清潔程序重新清潔設備
blocks.en: Re-clean: clean the equipment again using the validated cleaning procedure

blocks.zh: 熱水沖洗（Hot Water Flush）：使用已驗證的熱水沖洗程序，將微生物水準降回可接受範圍
blocks.en: Hot Water Flush: use a validated hot water flush procedure to bring the microbial level back within the acceptable range

blocks.zh: 兩者之後都需再次取樣確認生物負荷和內毒素符合規格。
blocks.en: After either action, sampling must be repeated to confirm that bioburden and endotoxin meet specification.

blocks.zh: Clean Hold 驗證的可移植性
blocks.en: Transferability of Clean Hold Validation

blocks.zh: 只要以下條件一致，同一設備的 clean hold 驗證結果可適用於所有使用該設備的產品和清潔程序：
blocks.en: As long as the following conditions are the same, the clean hold validation results for a given piece of equipment can be applied to all products and cleaning procedures that use that equipment:

blocks.zh: 清潔結束後設備的最終狀態（乾燥程度、表面殘留）
blocks.en: The final state of the equipment after cleaning (degree of dryness, surface residues)

blocks.zh: 儲存條件（溫度、濕度、密封方式）
blocks.en: Storage conditions (temperature, humidity, method of sealing)

blocks.zh: Practice Questions | 練習題
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Q1. Grouping Strategy | 分組策略
blocks.en: Q1. Grouping Strategy

blocks.zh: 您的設施使用相同生物反應槽生產五種類似的單株抗體（mAb）。即將引入 mAb-F，實驗室研究顯示其清潔難度比現有所有產品更難。請問引入 mAb-F 的清潔驗證要求是什麼？對現有驗證計畫有哪些影響？
blocks.en: Your facility uses the same bioreactor to produce five similar monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). mAb-F is about to be introduced, and laboratory studies show it is harder to clean than all existing products. What are the cleaning validation requirements for introducing mAb-F? What is the impact on the existing validation program?

blocks.zh: Q2. Single-Use vs Reusable | 一次性 vs 可重複使用
blocks.en: Q2. Single-Use vs Reusable

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 考慮將 200L 生物反應槽從不鏽鋼（可重複使用）改為一次性使用生物反應槽。哪些清潔驗證義務被消除？哪些新的確認/驗證義務被引入？有哪些關鍵風險需要考慮？
blocks.en: A CDMO is considering changing a 200 L bioreactor from stainless steel (reusable) to a single-use bioreactor. Which cleaning validation obligations are eliminated? Which new qualification/validation obligations are introduced? What key risks need to be considered?

blocks.zh: Q3. PAT Application | PAT 應用
blocks.en: Q3. PAT Application

blocks.zh: 一個生產團隊提議在 CIP 沖洗迴路安裝線上電導度感測器，當電導度降至 5 µS/cm 以下時沖洗步驟結束（取代固定的 15 分鐘沖洗）。這算是 PAT 應用嗎？需要哪些驗證工作才能實施這個方案？應該設計成能偵測哪些製程偏差？
blocks.en: A production team proposes installing an online conductivity sensor in the CIP rinse loop, ending the rinse step when conductivity falls below 5 µS/cm (replacing the fixed 15-minute rinse). Does this count as a PAT application? What validation work is needed to implement it? What process deviations should it be designed to detect?

blocks.zh: Q4. Clean Hold Exceedance | 超過保存時限
blocks.en: Q4. Clean Hold Exceedance

blocks.zh: 一個 500L 緩衝液製備容器在驗證的 72 小時清潔後保留研究後，因排程延誤被濕態儲存了 96 小時。請問可以採取哪些糾正措施？在容器可以使用之前需要哪些取樣和測試？是否需要重新進行清潔驗證？
blocks.en: After a validated 72-hour post-cleaning hold study, a 500 L buffer preparation vessel was stored wet for 96 hours because of a scheduling delay. What corrective actions can be taken? What sampling and testing are needed before the vessel can be used? Does cleaning validation need to be repeated?

blocks.zh: Q5. Viral Clearance Boundary | 病毒去活化邊界
blocks.en: Q5. Viral Clearance Boundary

blocks.zh: 一位 QA 稽核員質疑清潔驗證計畫是否充分解決病毒污染風險，指出哺乳動物細胞培養製程使用了動物來源原料。您如何解釋清潔驗證與病毒去活化研究之間的邊界？清潔在整體病毒生物污染控制策略中扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: A QA auditor questions whether the cleaning validation program adequately addresses the risk of viral contamination, noting that the mammalian cell culture process uses animal-derived raw materials. How would you explain the boundary between cleaning validation and viral clearance studies? What role does cleaning play in the overall viral contamination control strategy?

blocks.zh: Q6. Non-Product Contact Surfaces | 非產品接觸表面
blocks.en: Q6. Non-Product Contact Surfaces

blocks.zh: 一個配製團隊詢問凍乾機清潔驗證是否需要與充填線設備相同的殘留攜帶計算和驗收標準。為什麼傳統的殘留攜帶計算不適用於凍乾機？設定凍乾機清潔驗證 TOC 限度的兩種可接受方法是什麼？
blocks.en: A formulation team asks whether freeze dryer cleaning validation requires the same carryover calculation and acceptance criteria as filling line equipment. Why does the traditional carryover calculation not apply to freeze dryers? What are the two acceptable methods for setting the TOC limit in freeze dryer cleaning validation?
